component.name: Mario Kart Collection
component.summary: One launcher for eight Mario Kart recompilation projects

description.p: Mario Kart Collection is a focused library for eight existing Mario Kart recompilation projects. It reuses each game's original project and release packages instead of rebuilding or redistributing the game.

ul.li: Install and update from each project's own GitHub Releases
Keep each game's native runtime and setup flow intact
Use the common library, controller, local save and backup features
Launch games from one desktop app or Big Picture mode

description.p: No game files are included. Bring your own legally obtained game dumps and any project-specific keys or firmware.
First Mario Kart Collection release with eight curated Mario Kart recompilation projects, a refreshed racing-inspired interface, direct GitHub release updates, and local save backups.
